(3) Fix internal inconsistency: cherry_pick_moments[4] recommends flagging the '20 years without AC' bill-pain signal in the handoff, but handoff_brief.unresolved_concerns/closer_should_know never actually includes it — either add it to the handoff brief or remove the recommendation. (4) Correct script_coverage's button_up entry from a blanket 'skipped' to a partial breakdown consistent with cherry_pick_moments[5]/[6], which correctly identify that the one-hour-block element WAS delivered while the handshake, driving/computer instruction, and text-promise were not.
